coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 10 low-code internal-tool builders (Retool, Appsmith, ToolJet, Budibase, Superblocks, UI Bakery, Illa, Lowdefy, Refine, NocoBase). Coverage spans: (1) Official product pages (T0): homepages, pricing pages, documentation for all 10 products. (2) Analyst tiers (T2): Gartner Peer Insights market review, Forrester Q2 2026 Landscape report, market forecasts citing $44.5B TAM by 2026. (3) Review aggregates (T2): G2 reviews/ratings/comparisons (Retool 4.6/5, ToolJet 4.8/5, Appsmith 4.7/5, Budibase 4.5/5, Superblocks 4.7/5); Capterra pages for 8/10 products; TrustRadius low-code category; G2 direct comparisons (Appsmith vs Retool, ToolJet vs Budibase, etc.). (4) Changelogs (T1): Retool 4.0 stable release notes, Appsmith GitHub releases, ToolJet GitHub, Budibase/NocoBase/ILLA/Lowdefy/Refine GitHub repos. (5) Third-party comparative analysis (T3): ToolJet comprehensive blog series (ToolJet vs Appsmith vs Superblocks vs Retool 2026; Appsmith vs Budibase comparison), Superblocks reviews/comparisons, WeWeb buyers guides, Gartner Magic Quadrant leadership (OutSystems 9-year leader), Forrester predictions (75% of new apps on low-code by 2026), Medium technical deep-dives (performance tests, developer experience), Hacker News discussions. (6) HCI pain evidence (T3): Config sprawl analysis (Qovery, ToolJet), UI customization limitations, developer experience guides (Refine, Kissflow). Total 95+ distinct sources across 4 tiers.
